page0.text:
I know. It's all futile.
This little bow I made can't even scratch Berserker.
He won't bother to dodge the arrow; it can't possibly hurt him.
Probably all I'd do is get in the way and make things even harder for Saber.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-11:page0:1

page1.text:
I can't do anything.
Saber's about to collapse right in front of me, but I can't do anything.
If I ran...
If running at Berserker and punching him would save Saber, I'd have already done it.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-11:page1:1

page2.text:
But there'd be no point.
No matter what I do, I can only get in Saber's way.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-11:page2:1
